column1: # Result notices (成交结果公告) of purchases by filed bidding (备案竞价) that Wuhan University's procurement centre published on its own site (zb.whu.edu.cn), page dates Jun 27, 2025 to Nov 23, 2026: 81 notices, one row each. How made: the notices were picked from the site's own list of such notices by the words of their titles (graphics cards, GPUs, servers and AI computing), saved on Nov 23, 2026, and each row was read from the saved page by one script; on Nov 25, 2026 all 81 pages were read again the same way and gave the same rows. Columns: the saved id; the page's date (发布日期); the project name; the price of the award (成交金额, in yuan as printed; the notice of Apr 17, 2026, cn-le17-whu-124551, prints 38.6 on a form headed in yuan, with 万 as the unit of its goods line: kept as printed); every word found on the page from a list of Nvidia words (the maker's name as NVIDIA, Nvidia, nvidia, NVDIA, NVidia or 英伟达; card and chip names such as A100, 4090, 5090, 6000D and RTX PRO 6000; the architecture name Blackwell); every word found from a list for home-made hardware and imports (国产, 昇腾, 海光 and others, and three phrases the first list missed: 国内自主品牌, 国内一线品牌 and 非正规渠道进口产品); and up to 200 characters of the page around the first Nvidia word in its list of goods. The count in OFFICIAL_RECORD.md, section 5: 72 of the 81 rows are dated Sept 1, 2025 to Nov 23, 2026, and 23 of those 72 hold the maker's name in the fifth column; 6 more of the 72 hold only a card or architecture word there, 43 hold nothing. The sixth column is filled in 7 of the 72: 2 hold a home-made chip word or 国产; 4 more hold a clause asking for a home brand of server platform (国内自主品牌 or 国内一线品牌), each beside Nvidia words in the fifth column; 1 holds a clause refusing goods imported outside regular channels (非正规渠道进口产品), not imports as such. What the table is not: not a census of the university's purchases (the notices were picked by their titles, and a notice with another title is not here); a result notice records the award of a purchase, not a delivery and not an import; and a word on a page is not a statement of what was bought. Where the 200 characters of the last column run past the notice's own text they take in what follows the words 相关材料 (related materials): the names of its attached files, which the page shows, and the page's links to other news of the university, which stand in its code inside a comment that a browser does not show. Two cells keep a tail, an attached file's name each; eight are cut where the shown text of the notice ends, at 相关材料 or after the file's name. 11 of the 81 notices are also cited in tables/procurement_records.tsv.
